history_intro: Every day of the project, from the first Kaggle try on 26 October to today: what we tried, what happened, and what it cost.

spend_log.what: GLM test on a rented card, four attempts

chapters.when: 26 to 31 October: getting on the board
chapters.text: We split out our own repository, found both early Kaggle tries had crashed, then scored 0.651 with the public ensemble. Our own classifier scored 0.348 and our own Qwen model 0.585.
We repaired the memory crash, tested 6,000 bought passages three times, and watched their small gain disappear. An outside review said ten days of checks had not moved the board.

chapters.when: 9 to 10 November: run the public recipe
chapters.text: We reproduced the public 0.681 notebook, then reached 0.682, our best. Every model we mixed into it scored lower on the board.
The three-pass Qwen model finished training and was picked for the next test. The public 0.684 recipe is real. Style and GPT-correction ideas added nothing.
